checks.reason: The definition explicitly specifies delimiter field markers rather than stating the constraint in general candidate-agnostic terms.
checks.name: UNREQUESTED_CONTAINER_OR_WRAPPER_STRUCTURE
checks.definition: The agent emits output enclosed within an unrequested data container or wrapper, such as a dictionary or JSON object, rather than emitting top-level fields required by its instructions.
checks.when_to_use: Use when output is wrapped inside an unrequested dictionary, JSON object, or code container in violation of field layout instructions.
checks.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the output uses required top-level field formatting but contains factual or domain errors.

checks.subject: candidate
checks.reason: Names specific token artifacts like completion tags instead of stating the termination requirement generally.
checks.name: MISSING_OR_MALFORMED_REQUIRED_TERMINATION_ELEMENT
checks.definition: The output lacks a required closing termination element or emits a corrupted termination element at the conclusion of generation as specified by its instructions.
checks.when_to_use: Use when an agent fails to emit or truncates a required output termination marker at the conclusion of its turn.
checks.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the required termination marker is present and correctly structured.

checks.subject: candidate
checks.reason: Definition relies on specific construction details like missing hashtags and wrong brackets.
checks.name: MALFORMED_SECTION_OR_FIELD_DELIMITER
checks.definition: The agent emits section or field delimiters with syntax errors, missing framing characters, or improper sequence relative to its instructed format.
checks.when_to_use: Use when field or section markers are present in the output stream but contain bracket errors or syntax corruption.
checks.when_not_to_use: Do not use when section markers are missing entirely due to output being wrapped in an unrequested dictionary or JSON object.
